Recommended AC Action: Off / Fan Only: Air is dry; 24°C will feel cold. Raise setpoint to 25°C–26°C.
Low Cool: Minimal cooling load. Run higher setpoint or low fan speed.
Standard Cool Mode: Maintain baseline target temperature (24°C).
Target Offset: Lower setpoint by 1°C–2°C (22°C–23°C) to run compressor longer.
Dry Mode / High Cool: Sweat evaporation degrades rapidly. Prioritize dehumidification.
Maximum Dry Mode: Extreme latent heat load. Run Dry Mode or low target (20°C–21°C).
